evidenceReview.publicationTitle: WARM Version 16 Background and Management Practices
evidenceReview.limitation: Broad image categories are not WARM feedstocks; US grid, transport, landfill and operating assumptions are not Indian defaults.
Electricity per cubic metre of biogas is not electricity per kilogram of waste. Verified methane yield, volatile solids and plant efficiency are missing. The page is undated.
A photo cannot measure calorific value or verify authorized treatment infrastructure. This is not a numeric energy or carbon factor.
